principle: Translate Danny's v13 notes into eleven discrete, reproducible background tests. IBF-003 is rejected and omitted. Number fields use equal populations of the single digits 1 through 9 and 0, fixed size, fixed opacity, and coordinated planar motion. Curtain direction, palette, panel lightness, door acceleration, wipe acceleration, and hard resets are recorded explicitly while PDE-002 and subject geometry remain unchanged.

recipes.name: Dense overlapping number loop
recipes.description: A field of 420 bold, equal-size single digits covers more than half the background. The balanced digit population is assembled in a deterministic random order, and the entire plane follows one small closed path at one-quarter of the prior motion magnitude.

recipes.name: Coordinated slow number columns
recipes.description: Bold equal-size digits remain aligned in close columns. Every number shares the same very slow x-y movement, so the field behaves as one flat plane rather than as independently moving objects.

recipes.name: Coordinated columns — reversed palette
recipes.description: The coordinated column construction is repeated with its tonal relationship reversed: a darker warm field carries lighter digits. All numbers still share one slow velocity and retain one fixed size.

recipes.name: Gradient curtain — reversed colors
recipes.description: The accepted horizontal curtain repeats with its two warm neutral colors exchanging roles. The path remains a closed horizontal crossing and return.

recipes.name: Gradient curtain — top to bottom
recipes.description: The same two-tone curtain travels from the top toward the bottom and returns, testing a vertical event without changing the portrait or introducing depth.

recipes.name: Gradient curtain — fixed 31-degree angle
recipes.description: A reproducibly assigned 31-degree curtain crosses the flat background and returns. The angle is fixed in the manifest so a successful random direction can be recreated exactly.

recipes.name: One-way panel — light warm pair
recipes.description: A darker warm panel enters immediately and completes one full crossing during the 11 seconds. Replay cuts abruptly to the all-light first frame, inviting the motion to begin again.

recipes.name: One-way panel — quiet neutral pair
recipes.description: The same one-way 11-second crossing uses a second fixed lightness assignment: a quieter neutral light field and a cooler darker panel, followed by the same abrupt all-light replay.

recipes.name: Accelerating hinged door
recipes.description: The hinged plane begins slowly, then accelerates increasingly as it opens, with the strongest speed increase near the end. Replay deliberately restores the closed door.

recipes.name: Static-number accelerating wipe
recipes.description: A dense flat field of bold, equal-size digits remains completely still while a right-to-left wipe starts slowly and accelerates. The full panel cuts back to the restored number field at replay.

recipes.name: Moving-number accelerating wipe
recipes.description: The same dense equal-size number field moves left as one coordinated plane while the wipe accelerates from right to left. Every digit has the same velocity; none scales or suggests depth.
